# 01 geo index -- the existing Doris index already does C.1/C.2 (MEASURED)

MEASURED 2026-11-19T18:05Z on the plan-01 B.2 cluster (c05, master dbb9b19391 + plan commits, RELEASE),
with `h3_lat_lng_to_cell` standing in for `s2_cell` (same shape: BIGINT from lat/lon; the running binary
predates s2_cell).

## 1. Generated cell column + numeric inverted index: works today, no FE/BE change
```sql
CREATE TABLE geo.gc_probe (id BIGINT NOT NULL, lon DOUBLE NOT NULL, lat DOUBLE NOT NULL,
  cell BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (h3_lat_lng_to_cell(lat, lon, 9)),
  INDEX idx_cell (cell) USING INVERTED)
DUPLICATE KEY(id) DISTRIBUTED BY HASH(id) BUCKETS 4 PROPERTIES("replication_num"="1");
INSERT INTO geo.gc_probe (id, lon, lat) SELECT id, lon, lat FROM geo.geo_pts WHERE id < 100000;
```
100,000 rows loaded in 195 ms; `count(cell)` = 100,000.  The writer (plan 01 C.1) is the stock BKD
inverted-index writer: every segment gets a BKD tree on `cell` at load.  Nothing to build.

## 2. Range lookup prunes exactly -- once the BKD bypass heuristic is off
Query: `count(*) where cell between <p50> and <p51>` (1,001 hits of 100,000 rows), 4 segments.

| inverted_index_skip_threshold | RowsInvertedIndexFiltered | InvertedIndexDowngradeCount | ScanRows | RowsVectorPredFiltered |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 50 (default) | 12,589 | 7 | 87,411 | 86,410 |
| 0 | 98,999 | 0 | **1,001** | 0 |

- Cause (`be/src/storage/index/inverted/inverted_index_iterator.cpp:91-107`): for a BKD reader the
  iterator first counts the hits (`try_read_from_inverted_index`) and BYPASSES the index when the count is
  above `inverted_index_skip_threshold`% (default 50) of the segment's rows.  It downgraded 7 of the
  predicate evaluations here.  An `OR` of many `BETWEEN`s is evaluated range by range, so a range whose
  count is wrongly estimated trips the bypass.
- With the bypass off, ScanRows == hits: the reader (plan 01 C.2 "polygon -> row bitmap") is the stock BKD
  range query.  A polygon query = `(cell BETWEEN lo1 AND hi1 OR ...) AND ST_Contains(...)`, with the ranges
  from `geo_index::cover()` and Doris' own `ST_Contains` as the exact recheck.

## Consequences for plan 01 Phase C (KISS)
- C.1 writer: no new code.  DDL only: generated column `s2_cell(lat, lon)` + `INDEX ... USING INVERTED`.
- C.2 reader: no new index reader.  The new work is the planner rewrite: constant polygon -> cover() ranges
  -> OR of BETWEEN on the cell column, AND the original ST_Contains.
- The rewrite must keep the BKD index in use: either (a) set `inverted_index_skip_threshold = 0` for the
  rewritten predicate (session-level today; per-predicate needs a change), or (b) a single
  `cell IN RANGES(...)` predicate the BKD reader evaluates as one union (no per-range bypass).
  Pick by measurement in C.3 (KISS: (a) first).
